 653 | def resolve_weights(mode: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
 654 |     """Return (weights_dict, resolved_mode_name)."""
 655 |     if mode in WEIGHT_PRESETS:
 656 |         return WEIGHT_PRESETS[mode], mode
 657 |     # "random" or anything unrecognised → random
 658 |     return generate_random_weights(), "random"

 663 | def _sanitize(obj):
 664 |     """Recursively replace NaN/Inf floats with None so jsonify produces valid JSON."""
 665 |     if isinstance(obj, float):
 666 |         return None if (obj != obj or obj == float('inf') or obj == float('-inf')) else obj
 667 |     if isinstance(obj, dict):
 668 |         return {k: _sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
 669 |     if isinstance(obj, list):
 670 |         return [_sanitize(v) for v in obj]
 671 |     return obj
 672 | 
 673 | 
 674 | def _apply_weights(cached: dict, weights: dict) -> dict:
 675 |     """Re-score a cached result under a (possibly different) set of weights."""
 676 |     sub = cached.get("subScores", {})
 677 |     new_score = round(sum(sub.get(k, 50) * weights.get(k, 0) for k in weights), 1)
 678 |     result = dict(cached)
 679 |     result["score"] = new_score
 680 |     return result

 683 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict):
 684 |     # ── Check cache for raw ticker data ──────────────────────────────────────
 685 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 686 |     if cached:
 687 |         # Re-apply weights to cached sub-scores (mode may differ) and return
 688 |         return _apply_weights(cached, weights)
 689 | 
 690 |     # ── Cache miss — fetch from yfinance ─────────────────────────────────────
 691 |     try:
 692 |         stock = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 693 |         info  = stock.info or {}
 694 | 
 695 |         current_price = (
 696 |             info.get("currentPrice")
 697 |             or info.get("regularMarketPrice")
 698 |             or info.get("previousClose")
 699 |         )
 700 |         if not current_price:
 701 |             return None
 702 | 
 703 |         hist = stock.history(period="1y")
 704 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 705 |             return None
 706 |         prices = hist["Close"].dropna()  # drop trailing NaN from today's unfinished session
 707 |         if len(prices) < 30:
 708 |             return None
 709 | 
 710 |         rsi_val       = compute_rsi(prices)
 711 |         momentum      = compute_momentum_score(prices)
 712 |         ma_signal     = moving_average_signal(prices)
 713 | 
 714 |         pe            = info.get("forwardPE") or info.get("trailingPE")
 715 |         eps_growth    = info.get("earningsGrowth")
 716 |         debt_equity   = info.get("debtToEquity")
 717 |         profit_margin = info.get("profitMargins")
 718 |         short_pct     = info.get("shortPercentOfFloat")
 719 | 
 720 |         sub_scores = {
 721 |             "momentum":  momentum,
 722 |             "ma":        ma_signal,
 723 |             "pe":        score_pe(pe),
 724 |             "eps":       score_eps_growth(eps_growth * 100 if eps_growth else None),
 725 |             "debt":      score_debt_equity(debt_equity),
 726 |             "margin":    score_profit_margin(profit_margin),
 727 |             "rsi_score": score_rsi(rsi_val),
 728 |             "short":     score_short_interest(short_pct),
 729 |         }
 730 | 
 731 |         composite = sum(sub_scores[k] * weights[k] for k in weights)
 732 | 
 733 |         week52_low  = info.get("fiftyTwoWeekLow",  current_price * 0.7)
 734 |         week52_high = info.get("fiftyTwoWeekHigh", current_price * 1.3)
 735 |         range_pct   = round(

 737 |         )
 738 | 
 739 |         spark = prices.tail(90).round(2).tolist()
 740 | 
 741 |         sector = next(
 742 |             (s for s, tickers in STOCK_UNIVERSE.items() if ticker in tickers),
 743 |             info.get("sector", "Unknown"),
 744 |         )
 745 | 
 746 |         daily_change = info.get("regularMarketChangePercent", 0) or 0
 747 |         # yfinance already returns this as a full percentage (e.g. -3.42 means -3.42%)
 748 | 
 749 |         result = _sanitize({

 752 |             "sector":         sector,
 753 |             "score":          round(composite, 1),

 826 | @app.route("/api/minigame/hint")
 827 | def minigame_hint():
 828 |     """Return one recent news item for a ticker, with the ticker symbol
 829 |     scrubbed from the headline so it doesn't spoil the minigame answer."""
 830 |     ticker = request.args.get("ticker", "").strip().upper()
 831 |     if not ticker:
 832 |         return jsonify({"error": "ticker param required"}), 400
 833 | 
 834 |     try:
 835 |         stock  = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 836 |         news   = stock.news or []
 837 | 
 838 |         # yfinance ≥0.2.x wraps articles in a "content" sub-object;
 839 |         # older versions expose fields at the top level — handle both.
 840 |         def _normalise(item: dict) -> dict:
 841 |             c = item.get("content", item)
 842 |             title   = c.get("title", "")
 843 |             summary = c.get("summary", c.get("description", ""))
 844 |             url     = (c.get("canonicalUrl") or c.get("clickThroughUrl") or {}).get("url", "")
 845 |             source  = (c.get("provider") or {}).get("displayName", "")
 846 |             pub     = c.get("pubDate", c.get("providerPublishTime", ""))
 847 |             return {"title": title, "summary": summary, "url": url,
 848 |                     "source": source, "publishedAt": pub}
 849 | 
 850 |         articles = [_normalise(n) for n in news if n]
 851 |         # Filter to articles that have a title and a URL
 852 |         articles = [a for a in articles if a["title"] and a["url"]]
 853 | 
 854 |         if not articles:
 855 |             return jsonify({"error": "No news available for this ticker"}), 404
 856 | 
 857 |         # Scrub the ticker symbol (and common company-name fragments) from
 858 |         # title + summary so the answer is not given away outright.
 859 |         import re as _re
 860 |         def _scrub(text: str) -> str:
 861 |             # Remove bare ticker in parens like "(AAPL)" or "NASDAQ: AAPL"
 862 |             text = _re.sub(
 863 |                 r'\b(NYSE|NASDAQ|AMEX)[\s:]+' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
 864 |                 '[undisclosed]', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
 865 |             text = _re.sub(
 866 |                 r'\(' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\)',
 867 |                 '([?])', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
 868 |             # Remove standalone all-caps ticker as a whole word
 869 |             text = _re.sub(
 870 |                 r'\b' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
 871 |                 '[?]', text)
 872 |             return text
 873 | 
 874 |         # Pick the first article that doesn't lead with the raw ticker symbol
 875 |         chosen = articles[0]
 876 |         for a in articles:
 877 |             if not a["title"].strip().upper().startswith(ticker):
 878 |                 chosen = a
 879 |                 break
 880 | 
 881 |         chosen["title"]   = _scrub(chosen["title"])
 882 |         chosen["summary"] = _scrub(chosen["summary"])[:280]  # cap summary length
 883 | 
 884 |         logger.info("minigame-hint: %s → %s", ticker, chosen["title"][:60])
 885 |         return jsonify(chosen)
 886 | 
 887 |     except Exception as exc:
 888 |         logger.warning("minigame-hint failed for %s: %s", ticker, exc)

 925 |         if pe and pe > 60:

 177 | # ── Per-ticker fetch + score ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 178 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
 179 |     """
 180 |     Fetch market data for *ticker* and compute a weighted AI score.
 181 |     Fast path: if in 5-min price cache, re-score with current weights and return.
 182 |     Fundamentals served from 4-hour cache — yfinance .info fires at most once/4 h.
 183 |     """
 184 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 185 |     if cached:
 186 |         cached = dict(cached)
 187 |         cached["score"] = _apply_weights(cached["subScores"], weights)
 188 |         return cached
 189 | 
 190 |     try:
 191 |         tk   = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 192 |         hist = tk.history(period="1y", auto_adjust=True)
 193 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 194 |             return None
 195 | 
 196 |         close   = hist["Close"]
 197 |         volume  = hist["Volume"]
 198 |         current = float(close.iloc[-1])
 199 | 
 200 |         change_1d = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-2]) / close.iloc[-2] * 100) \
 201 |                     if len(close) >= 2 else 0.0
 202 |         mom_1m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-21]) / close.iloc[-21] * 100) \
 203 |                     if len(close) >= 21 else 0.0
 204 |         mom_3m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-63]) / close.iloc[-63] * 100) \
 205 |                     if len(close) >= 63 else 0.0
 206 | 
 207 |         ma_50  = float(close.tail(50).mean())  if len(close) >= 50  else current
 208 |         ma_200 = float(close.tail(200).mean()) if len(close) >= 200 else current
 209 | 
 210 |         delta   = close.diff()
 211 |         gain    = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
 212 |         loss    = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
 213 |         rs      = gain / loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 214 |         rsi_val = float(100 - 100 / (1 + rs.iloc[-1]))
 215 |         if np.isnan(rsi_val):
 216 |             rsi_val = 50.0
 217 | 
 218 |         avg_vol   = float(volume.tail(20).mean())
 219 |         spark_raw = close.tail(30).tolist()
 220 |         mn, mx    = min(spark_raw), max(spark_raw)
 221 |         spark     = [round((v - mn) / (mx - mn) * 100, 1) if mx > mn else 50.0
 222 |                      for v in spark_raw]
 223 | 
 224 |         fund = _fund_get(ticker)
 225 |         if fund is None:
 226 |             info       = tk.info
 227 |             pe_raw     = info.get("trailingPE")       or info.get("forwardPE")
 228 |             eps_raw    = info.get("earningsGrowth")   or info.get("revenueGrowth")
 229 |             margin_raw = info.get("profitMargins")
 230 |             debt_raw   = info.get("debtToEquity")
 231 |             short_raw  = info.get("shortPercentOfFloat") or info.get("shortRatio", 0)
 232 |             fund = {
 233 |                 "pe":           float(pe_raw)     if pe_raw     is not None else None,
 234 |                 "epsGrowth":    float(eps_raw)    if eps_raw    is not None else None,
 235 |                 "profitMargin": float(margin_raw) if margin_raw is not None else None,
 236 |                 "debtToEquity": float(debt_raw)   if debt_raw   is not None else None,
 237 |                 "shortPct":     float(short_raw)  if short_raw  is not None else 0.0,
 238 |                 "sector":  info.get("sector", "Unknown"),
 239 |                 "mktCap":  info.get("marketCap"),
 240 |                 "name":    info.get("shortName") or info.get("longName") or ticker,
 241 |             }
 242 |             _fund_set(ticker, fund)
 243 | 
 244 |         sub = {}
 245 |         blend = mom_1m * 0.4 + mom_3m * 0.6
 246 |         sub["momentum"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + blend * 1.5))
 247 | 
 248 |         eg = fund["epsGrowth"]
 249 |         sub["eps"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + eg * 150)) if eg is not None else 50.0
 250 | 
 251 |         pe = fund["pe"]
 252 |         sub["pe"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - (pe - 15) * 1.8)) \
 253 |                     if (pe is not None and pe > 0) else 50.0
 254 | 
 255 |         if current > ma_50 > ma_200:
 256 |             sub["ma"] = 85.0
 257 |         elif current > ma_200:
 258 |             sub["ma"] = 65.0
 259 |         elif current > ma_50:
 260 |             sub["ma"] = 55.0
 261 |         else:
 262 |             sub["ma"] = 30.0
 263 | 
 264 |         pm = fund["profitMargin"]
 265 |         sub["margin"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + pm * 250)) if pm is not None else 50.0
 266 | 
 267 |         de = fund["debtToEquity"]
 268 |         sub["debt"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - de * 0.5)) if de is not None else 50.0
 269 | 
 270 |         if rsi_val < 30:
 271 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 80.0
 272 |         elif rsi_val < 45:
 273 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 65.0
 274 |         elif rsi_val < 60:
 275 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 55.0
 276 |         elif rsi_val < 72:
 277 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 40.0
 278 |         else:
 279 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 20.0
 280 | 
 281 |         sp = fund["shortPct"]
 282 |         sub["short"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - sp * 300))
 283 | 
 284 |         score = _apply_weights(sub, weights)
 285 | 
 286 |         result = {
 287 |             "ticker":       ticker,
 288 |             "name":         fund["name"],
 289 |             "currentPrice": round(current, 2),
 290 |             "change1d":     round(change_1d, 2),
 291 |             "ma50":         round(ma_50,  2),
 292 |             "ma200":        round(ma_200, 2),
 293 |             "rsi":          round(rsi_val, 1),
 294 |             "avgVolume":    int(avg_vol),
 295 |             "spark":        spark,
 296 |             "pe":           round(fund["pe"], 2)                 if fund["pe"]           is not None else None,
 297 |             "epsGrowth":    round(fund["epsGrowth"] * 100, 1)    if fund["epsGrowth"]    is not None else None,
 298 |             "profitMargin": round(fund["profitMargin"] * 100, 1) if fund["profitMargin"] is not None else None,
 299 |             "debtToEquity": round(fund["debtToEquity"], 2)       if fund["debtToEquity"] is not None else None,
 300 |             "sector":       fund["sector"],
 301 |             "mktCap":       int(fund["mktCap"]) if fund["mktCap"] is not None else None,
 302 |             "subScores":    {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sub.items()},
 303 |             "score":        score,
 304 |         }
 305 |         _cache_set(ticker, result)
 306 |         return result
 307 | 
 308 |     except Exception as exc:
 309 |         logger.warning("fetch_and_score(%s) failed: %s", ticker, exc)

 314 | _EXECUTOR = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20, thread_name_prefix="stock-fetch")

 317 | def score_tickers_parallel(tickers: list, weights: dict) -> list:
 318 |     """Score tickers in parallel (up to 20 threads). Drops None results."""
 319 |     futures = {_EXECUTOR.submit(fetch_and_score, t, weights): t for t in tickers}
 320 |     results = []
 321 |     for fut in as_completed(futures):
 322 |         try:
 323 |             res = fut.result(timeout=20)
 324 |             if res:
 325 |                 results.append(res)
 326 |         except Exception as exc:
 327 |             logger.warning("Worker error for %s: %s", futures[fut], exc)
 328 |     return results

 558 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 559 |     delta = prices.diff()
 560 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 561 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 562 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 563 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 564 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 565 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 566 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 567 | 
 568 | 
 569 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 570 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 571 |         return 50.0
 572 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 573 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 574 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 575 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 576 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 577 | 
 578 | 
 579 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 580 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 581 |         return 50.0
 582 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 583 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 584 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 585 |     score = 50.0
 586 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 587 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 588 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 589 |     return min(100.0, score)

 592 | def score_pe(pe):

 594 |     if pe < 8:   return 55.0
 595 |     if pe <= 15: return 90.0
 596 |     if pe <= 25: return 75.0
 597 |     if pe <= 40: return 55.0
 598 |     return max(0.0, 55.0 - (pe - 40) * 0.5)

 637 | def score_short_interest(short_pct_float) -> float:
 638 |     """
 639 |     Score short interest (% of float sold short) as a contrarian signal.
 640 |     - Very low  (<3%)  : neutral — no squeeze fuel, score 55
 641 |     - Low       (3–10%): healthy skepticism, score 65
 642 |     - Moderate  (10–20%): elevated but manageable, score 75 (squeeze potential)
 643 |     - High      (20–30%): significant short interest, score 85 (strong squeeze setup)
 644 |     - Very high (>30%) : extreme risk / possible value trap, score 40
 645 |     - Missing data      : neutral 50

 647 |     if short_pct_float is None:
 648 |         return 50.0
 649 |     pct = short_pct_float * 100  # convert 0.12 → 12.0
 650 |     if pct > 30:   return 40.0
 651 |     if pct > 20:   return 85.0
 652 |     if pct > 10:   return 75.0
 653 |     if pct >= 3:   return 65.0
 654 |     return 55.0

 704 | # Per-signal hard bounds to keep random weights sane [min, max]
 705 | SIGNAL_BOUNDS = {
 706 |     "momentum":  (0.05, 0.40),
 707 |     "ma":        (0.03, 0.30),
 708 |     "pe":        (0.03, 0.35),
 709 |     "eps":       (0.05, 0.40),

 717 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 718 |     """
 719 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 720 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 721 |     """
 722 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 723 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 724 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 725 | 
 726 |     weights = {}
 727 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 728 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 729 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 730 | 
 731 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 732 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 733 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 734 | 
 735 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 736 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 737 |     if diff:
 738 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 739 | 
 740 |     return weights

 744 |     """Return (weights_dict, resolved_mode_name)."""
 745 |     if mode in WEIGHT_PRESETS:
 746 |         return WEIGHT_PRESETS[mode], mode
 747 |     # "random" or anything unrecognised → random
 748 |     return generate_random_weights(), "random"

 753 | def _sanitize(obj):
 754 |     """Recursively replace NaN/Inf floats with None so jsonify produces valid JSON."""
 755 |     if isinstance(obj, float):
 756 |         return None if (obj != obj or obj == float('inf') or obj == float('-inf')) else obj
 757 |     if isinstance(obj, dict):
 758 |         return {k: _sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
 759 |     if isinstance(obj, list):
 760 |         return [_sanitize(v) for v in obj]
 761 |     return obj

 763 | 
 764 | def _apply_weights(cached: dict, weights: dict) -> dict:
 765 |     """Re-score a cached result under a (possibly different) set of weights."""
 766 |     sub = cached.get("subScores", {})
 767 |     new_score = round(sum(sub.get(k, 50) * weights.get(k, 0) for k in weights), 1)
 768 |     result = dict(cached)
 769 |     result["score"] = new_score
 770 |     return result

 773 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict):
 774 |     # ── Check cache for raw ticker data ──────────────────────────────────────
 775 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 776 |     if cached:
 777 |         # Re-apply weights to cached sub-scores (mode may differ) and return
 778 |         return _apply_weights(cached, weights)
 779 | 
 780 |     # ── Cache miss — fetch from yfinance ─────────────────────────────────────
 781 |     try:
 782 |         stock = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 783 |         info  = stock.info or {}
 784 | 
 785 |         current_price = (
 786 |             info.get("currentPrice")
 787 |             or info.get("regularMarketPrice")
 788 |             or info.get("previousClose")
 789 |         )
 790 |         if not current_price:
 791 |             return None
 792 | 
 793 |         hist = stock.history(period="1y")
 794 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 795 |             return None
 796 |         prices = hist["Close"].dropna()  # drop trailing NaN from today's unfinished session
 797 |         if len(prices) < 30:
 798 |             return None
 799 | 
 800 |         rsi_val       = compute_rsi(prices)
 801 |         momentum      = compute_momentum_score(prices)
 802 |         ma_signal     = moving_average_signal(prices)
 803 | 
 804 |         pe            = info.get("forwardPE") or info.get("trailingPE")
 805 |         eps_growth    = info.get("earningsGrowth")
 806 |         debt_equity   = info.get("debtToEquity")

 808 |         short_pct     = info.get("shortPercentOfFloat")
 809 | 
 810 |         sub_scores = {

 812 |             "ma":        ma_signal,
 813 |             "pe":        score_pe(pe),

 815 |             "debt":      score_debt_equity(debt_equity),

 817 |             "rsi_score": score_rsi(rsi_val),
 818 |             "short":     score_short_interest(short_pct),
 819 |         }
 820 | 
 821 |         composite = sum(sub_scores[k] * weights[k] for k in weights)
 822 | 
 823 |         week52_low  = info.get("fiftyTwoWeekLow",  current_price * 0.7)

 829 |         spark = prices.tail(90).round(2).tolist()
 830 | 
 831 |         sector = next(

 839 |         result = _sanitize({

 916 | @app.route("/api/minigame/hint")
 917 | def minigame_hint():
 918 |     """Return one recent news item for a ticker, with the ticker symbol
 919 |     scrubbed from the headline so it doesn't spoil the minigame answer."""
 920 |     ticker = request.args.get("ticker", "").strip().upper()
 921 |     if not ticker:
 922 |         return jsonify({"error": "ticker param required"}), 400
 923 | 
 924 |     try:
 925 |         stock  = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 926 |         news   = stock.news or []
 927 | 
 928 |         # yfinance ≥0.2.x wraps articles in a "content" sub-object;
 929 |         # older versions expose fields at the top level — handle both.
 930 |         def _normalise(item: dict) -> dict:
 931 |             c = item.get("content", item)
 932 |             title   = c.get("title", "")
 933 |             summary = c.get("summary", c.get("description", ""))
 934 |             url     = (c.get("canonicalUrl") or c.get("clickThroughUrl") or {}).get("url", "")
 935 |             source  = (c.get("provider") or {}).get("displayName", "")
 936 |             pub     = c.get("pubDate", c.get("providerPublishTime", ""))
 937 |             return {"title": title, "summary": summary, "url": url,
 938 |                     "source": source, "publishedAt": pub}
 939 | 
 940 |         articles = [_normalise(n) for n in news if n]
 941 |         # Filter to articles that have a title and a URL
 942 |         articles = [a for a in articles if a["title"] and a["url"]]
 943 | 
 944 |         if not articles:
 945 |             return jsonify({"error": "No news available for this ticker"}), 404
 946 | 
 947 |         # Scrub the ticker symbol (and common company-name fragments) from
 948 |         # title + summary so the answer is not given away outright.
 949 |         import re as _re
 950 |         def _scrub(text: str) -> str:
 951 |             # Remove bare ticker in parens like "(AAPL)" or "NASDAQ: AAPL"
 952 |             text = _re.sub(
 953 |                 r'\b(NYSE|NASDAQ|AMEX)[\s:]+' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
 954 |                 '[undisclosed]', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
 955 |             text = _re.sub(
 956 |                 r'\(' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\)',
 957 |                 '([?])', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
 958 |             # Remove standalone all-caps ticker as a whole word
 959 |             text = _re.sub(
 960 |                 r'\b' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
 961 |                 '[?]', text)
 962 |             return text
 963 | 
 964 |         # Pick the first article that doesn't lead with the raw ticker symbol
 965 |         chosen = articles[0]
 966 |         for a in articles:
 967 |             if not a["title"].strip().upper().startswith(ticker):
 968 |                 chosen = a
 969 |                 break
 970 | 
 971 |         chosen["title"]   = _scrub(chosen["title"])
 972 |         chosen["summary"] = _scrub(chosen["summary"])[:280]  # cap summary length
 973 | 
 974 |         logger.info("minigame-hint: %s → %s", ticker, chosen["title"][:60])
 975 |         return jsonify(chosen)
 976 | 
 977 |     except Exception as exc:
 978 |         logger.warning("minigame-hint failed for %s: %s", ticker, exc)
 979 |         return jsonify({"error": str(exc)}), 500

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 |

 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 |

 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}

  81 | FUND_CACHE_TTL = 14400  # 4 hour — PE, EPS growth, margins, D/E
  82 | CACHE_MAXSIZE  = 200    # max entries in tier-1 before LRU eviction

  92 | def _cache_get(ticker: str) -> Optional[dict]:
  93 |     """Return tier-1 cached data (fresh within CACHE_TTL), or None."""
  94 |     with _cache_lock:

  96 |         if entry:
  97 |             if (time.time() - entry["ts"]) < CACHE_TTL:
  98 |                 _cache.move_to_end(ticker)
  99 |                 _cache_stats["hits"] += 1
 100 |                 return entry["data"]
 101 |             del _cache[ticker]
 102 |         _cache_stats["misses"] += 1
 103 |     return None

 164 | def _random_weights() -> dict:

 171 | def _apply_weights(sub_scores: dict, weights: dict) -> float:
 172 |     total = sum(weights.get(k, 0) * v for k, v in sub_scores.items())
 173 |     w_sum = sum(weights.get(k, 0) for k in sub_scores)
 174 |     return round(total / w_sum, 1) if w_sum else 0.0

 177 | # ── Per-ticker fetch + score ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 178 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
 179 |     """
 180 |     Fetch market data for *ticker* and compute a weighted AI score.
 181 |     Fast path: if in 5-min price cache, re-score with current weights and return.
 182 |     Fundamentals served from 4-hour cache — yfinance .info fires at most once/4 h.
 183 |     """
 184 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 185 |     if cached:
 186 |         cached = dict(cached)
 187 |         cached["score"] = _apply_weights(cached["subScores"], weights)
 188 |         return cached
 189 | 
 190 |     try:
 191 |         tk   = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 192 |         hist = tk.history(period="1y", auto_adjust=True)
 193 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 194 |             return None
 195 | 
 196 |         close   = hist["Close"]
 197 |         volume  = hist["Volume"]
 198 |         current = float(close.iloc[-1])
 199 | 
 200 |         change_1d = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-2]) / close.iloc[-2] * 100) \
 201 |                     if len(close) >= 2 else 0.0
 202 |         mom_1m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-21]) / close.iloc[-21] * 100) \
 203 |                     if len(close) >= 21 else 0.0
 204 |         mom_3m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-63]) / close.iloc[-63] * 100) \
 205 |                     if len(close) >= 63 else 0.0
 206 | 
 207 |         ma_50  = float(close.tail(50).mean())  if len(close) >= 50  else current
 208 |         ma_200 = float(close.tail(200).mean()) if len(close) >= 200 else current
 209 | 
 210 |         delta   = close.diff()
 211 |         gain    = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
 212 |         loss    = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
 213 |         rs      = gain / loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 214 |         rsi_val = float(100 - 100 / (1 + rs.iloc[-1]))
 215 |         if np.isnan(rsi_val):
 216 |             rsi_val = 50.0
 217 | 
 218 |         avg_vol   = float(volume.tail(20).mean())
 219 |         spark_raw = close.tail(30).tolist()
 220 |         mn, mx    = min(spark_raw), max(spark_raw)
 221 |         spark     = [round((v - mn) / (mx - mn) * 100, 1) if mx > mn else 50.0
 222 |                      for v in spark_raw]
 223 | 
 224 |         fund = _fund_get(ticker)
 225 |         if fund is None:
 226 |             info       = tk.info
 227 |             pe_raw     = info.get("trailingPE")       or info.get("forwardPE")
 228 |             eps_raw    = info.get("earningsGrowth")   or info.get("revenueGrowth")
 229 |             margin_raw = info.get("profitMargins")
 230 |             debt_raw   = info.get("debtToEquity")
 231 |             short_raw  = info.get("shortPercentOfFloat") or info.get("shortRatio", 0)
 232 |             fund = {
 233 |                 "pe":           float(pe_raw)     if pe_raw     is not None else None,
 234 |                 "epsGrowth":    float(eps_raw)    if eps_raw    is not None else None,
 235 |                 "profitMargin": float(margin_raw) if margin_raw is not None else None,
 236 |                 "debtToEquity": float(debt_raw)   if debt_raw   is not None else None,
 237 |                 "shortPct":     float(short_raw)  if short_raw  is not None else 0.0,
 238 |                 "sector":  info.get("sector", "Unknown"),
 239 |                 "mktCap":  info.get("marketCap"),
 240 |                 "name":    info.get("shortName") or info.get("longName") or ticker,
 241 |             }
 242 |             _fund_set(ticker, fund)
 243 | 
 244 |         sub = {}
 245 |         blend = mom_1m * 0.4 + mom_3m * 0.6
 246 |         sub["momentum"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + blend * 1.5))
 247 | 
 248 |         eg = fund["epsGrowth"]
 249 |         sub["eps"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + eg * 150)) if eg is not None else 50.0
 250 | 
 251 |         pe = fund["pe"]
 252 |         sub["pe"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - (pe - 15) * 1.8)) \
 253 |                     if (pe is not None and pe > 0) else 50.0
 254 | 
 255 |         if current > ma_50 > ma_200:
 256 |             sub["ma"] = 85.0
 257 |         elif current > ma_200:
 258 |             sub["ma"] = 65.0
 259 |         elif current > ma_50:
 260 |             sub["ma"] = 55.0
 261 |         else:
 262 |             sub["ma"] = 30.0
 263 | 
 264 |         pm = fund["profitMargin"]
 265 |         sub["margin"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + pm * 250)) if pm is not None else 50.0
 266 | 
 267 |         de = fund["debtToEquity"]
 268 |         sub["debt"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - de * 0.5)) if de is not None else 50.0
 269 | 
 270 |         if rsi_val < 30:
 271 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 80.0
 272 |         elif rsi_val < 45:
 273 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 65.0
 274 |         elif rsi_val < 60:
 275 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 55.0
 276 |         elif rsi_val < 72:
 277 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 40.0
 278 |         else:
 279 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 20.0
 280 | 
 281 |         sp = fund["shortPct"]
 282 |         sub["short"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - sp * 300))
 283 | 
 284 |         score = _apply_weights(sub, weights)
 285 | 
 286 |         result = {
 287 |             "ticker":       ticker,
 288 |             "name":         fund["name"],
 289 |             "currentPrice": round(current, 2),
 290 |             "change1d":     round(change_1d, 2),
 291 |             "ma50":         round(ma_50,  2),
 292 |             "ma200":        round(ma_200, 2),
 293 |             "rsi":          round(rsi_val, 1),
 294 |             "avgVolume":    int(avg_vol),
 295 |             "spark":        spark,
 296 |             "pe":           round(fund["pe"], 2)                 if fund["pe"]           is not None else None,
 297 |             "epsGrowth":    round(fund["epsGrowth"] * 100, 1)    if fund["epsGrowth"]    is not None else None,
 298 |             "profitMargin": round(fund["profitMargin"] * 100, 1) if fund["profitMargin"] is not None else None,
 299 |             "debtToEquity": round(fund["debtToEquity"], 2)       if fund["debtToEquity"] is not None else None,
 300 |             "sector":       fund["sector"],
 301 |             "mktCap":       int(fund["mktCap"]) if fund["mktCap"] is not None else None,
 302 |             "subScores":    {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sub.items()},
 303 |             "score":        score,
 304 |         }
 305 |         _cache_set(ticker, result)
 306 |         return result
 307 | 
 308 |     except Exception as exc:
 309 |         logger.warning("fetch_and_score(%s) failed: %s", ticker, exc)
 310 |         return None

 313 | # ── Parallel batch scorer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 314 | _EXECUTOR = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20, thread_name_prefix="stock-fetch")
 315 | 
 316 | 
 317 | def score_tickers_parallel(tickers: list, weights: dict) -> list:
 318 |     """Score tickers in parallel (up to 20 threads). Drops None results."""
 319 |     futures = {_EXECUTOR.submit(fetch_and_score, t, weights): t for t in tickers}
 320 |     results = []
 321 |     for fut in as_completed(futures):
 322 |         try:
 323 |             res = fut.result(timeout=20)
 324 |             if res:
 325 |                 results.append(res)
 326 |         except Exception as exc:
 327 |             logger.warning("Worker error for %s: %s", futures[fut], exc)
 328 |     return results

 585 | def _cache_set(ticker: str, data: dict) -> None:
 586 |     """Insert or refresh entry; evict LRU entry if capacity is exceeded."""
 587 |     if ticker in _cache:

 604 | 
 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 639 | def score_pe(pe):
 640 |     if pe is None or pe <= 0: return 40.0
 641 |     if pe < 8:   return 55.0
 642 |     if pe <= 15: return 90.0
 643 |     if pe <= 25: return 75.0
 644 |     if pe <= 40: return 55.0
 645 |     return max(0.0, 55.0 - (pe - 40) * 0.5)

 650 |     if eps_growth >= 30:  return 100.0
 651 |     if eps_growth >= 15:  return 80.0
 652 |     if eps_growth >= 5:   return 60.0
 653 |     if eps_growth >= 0:   return 45.0
 654 |     return max(0.0, 45.0 + eps_growth)

 684 | def score_short_interest(short_pct_float) -> float:
 685 |     """
 686 |     Score short interest (% of float sold short) as a contrarian signal.
 687 |     - Very low  (<3%)  : neutral — no squeeze fuel, score 55
 688 |     - Low       (3–10%): healthy skepticism, score 65
 689 |     - Moderate  (10–20%): elevated but manageable, score 75 (squeeze potential)
 690 |     - High      (20–30%): significant short interest, score 85 (strong squeeze setup)
 691 |     - Very high (>30%) : extreme risk / possible value trap, score 40
 692 |     - Missing data      : neutral 50
 693 |     """
 694 |     if short_pct_float is None:
 695 |         return 50.0
 696 |     pct = short_pct_float * 100  # convert 0.12 → 12.0
 697 |     if pct > 30:   return 40.0
 698 |     if pct > 20:   return 85.0
 699 |     if pct > 10:   return 75.0
 700 |     if pct >= 3:   return 65.0
 701 |     return 55.0

 737 | # Named presets — weights must sum to 1.0 across all 8 signals.
 738 | WEIGHT_PRESETS = {
 739 |     "balanced":  {"momentum": 0.18, "ma": 0.13, "pe": 0.13, "eps": 0.18,
 740 |                   "debt": 0.10, "margin": 0.10, "rsi_score": 0.10, "short": 0.08},

 744 |                   "debt": 0.10, "margin": 0.10, "rsi_score": 0.05, "short": 0.05},
 745 |     "quality":   {"momentum": 0.10, "ma": 0.05, "pe": 0.10, "eps": 0.18,
 746 |                   "debt": 0.18, "margin": 0.23, "rsi_score": 0.10, "short": 0.06},
 747 |     "technical": {"momentum": 0.22, "ma": 0.27, "pe": 0.05, "eps": 0.05,
 748 |                   "debt": 0.05, "margin": 0.05, "rsi_score": 0.22, "short": 0.09},
 749 | }
 750 | 
 751 | # Per-signal hard bounds to keep random weights sane [min, max]
 752 | SIGNAL_BOUNDS = {
 753 |     "momentum":  (0.05, 0.40),
 754 |     "ma":        (0.03, 0.30),
 755 |     "pe":        (0.03, 0.35),
 756 |     "eps":       (0.05, 0.40),
 757 |     "debt":      (0.03, 0.20),
 758 |     "margin":    (0.03, 0.20),
 759 |     "rsi_score": (0.03, 0.22),
 760 |     "short":     (0.03, 0.20),
 761 | }

 763 | 
 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 781 | 
 782 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 783 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 784 |     if diff:
 785 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 786 | 
 787 |     return weights
 788 |

 792 |     if mode in WEIGHT_PRESETS:
 793 |         return WEIGHT_PRESETS[mode], mode
 794 |     # "random" or anything unrecognised → random
 795 |     return generate_random_weights(), "random"

 800 | def _sanitize(obj):
 801 |     """Recursively replace NaN/Inf floats with None so jsonify produces valid JSON."""
 802 |     if isinstance(obj, float):
 803 |         return None if (obj != obj or obj == float('inf') or obj == float('-inf')) else obj
 804 |     if isinstance(obj, dict):
 805 |         return {k: _sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
 806 |     if isinstance(obj, list):
 807 |         return [_sanitize(v) for v in obj]
 808 |     return obj

 811 | def _apply_weights(cached: dict, weights: dict) -> dict:
 812 |     """Re-score a cached result under a (possibly different) set of weights."""
 813 |     sub = cached.get("subScores", {})
 814 |     new_score = round(sum(sub.get(k, 50) * weights.get(k, 0) for k in weights), 1)
 815 |     result = dict(cached)
 816 |     result["score"] = new_score
 817 |     return result

 820 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict):

 825 |         return _apply_weights(cached, weights)

 828 |     try:
 829 |         stock = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 830 |         info  = stock.info or {}
 831 | 
 832 |         current_price = (
 833 |             info.get("currentPrice")

 836 |         )

 840 |         hist = stock.history(period="1y")

 844 |         if len(prices) < 30:

 846 |

 850 |

 852 |         eps_growth    = info.get("earningsGrowth")
 853 |         debt_equity   = info.get("debtToEquity")

 856 | 
 857 |         sub_scores = {

 862 |             "debt":      score_debt_equity(debt_equity),

 867 | 
 868 |         composite = sum(sub_scores[k] * weights[k] for k in weights)
 869 | 
 870 |         week52_low  = info.get("fiftyTwoWeekLow",  current_price * 0.7)

 877 | 
 878 |         sector = next(

 964 | def minigame_hint():
 965 |     """Return one recent news item for a ticker, with the ticker symbol
 966 |     scrubbed from the headline so it doesn't spoil the minigame answer."""
 967 |     ticker = request.args.get("ticker", "").strip().upper()

 971 |     try:
 972 |         stock  = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 973 |         news   = stock.news or []
 974 | 
 975 |         # yfinance ≥0.2.x wraps articles in a "content" sub-object;
 976 |         # older versions expose fields at the top level — handle both.
 977 |         def _normalise(item: dict) -> dict:
 978 |             c = item.get("content", item)
 979 |             title   = c.get("title", "")
 980 |             summary = c.get("summary", c.get("description", ""))
 981 |             url     = (c.get("canonicalUrl") or c.get("clickThroughUrl") or {}).get("url", "")
 982 |             source  = (c.get("provider") or {}).get("displayName", "")
 983 |             pub     = c.get("pubDate", c.get("providerPublishTime", ""))
 984 |             return {"title": title, "summary": summary, "url": url,
 985 |                     "source": source, "publishedAt": pub}
 986 | 
 987 |         articles = [_normalise(n) for n in news if n]
 988 |         # Filter to articles that have a title and a URL
 989 |         articles = [a for a in articles if a["title"] and a["url"]]
 990 | 
 991 |         if not articles:
 992 |             return jsonify({"error": "No news available for this ticker"}), 404
 993 | 
 994 |         # Scrub the ticker symbol (and common company-name fragments) from
 995 |         # title + summary so the answer is not given away outright.
 996 |         import re as _re
 997 |         def _scrub(text: str) -> str:
 998 |             # Remove bare ticker in parens like "(AAPL)" or "NASDAQ: AAPL"
 999 |             text = _re.sub(
1000 |                 r'\b(NYSE|NASDAQ|AMEX)[\s:]+' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
1001 |                 '[undisclosed]', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
1002 |             text = _re.sub(
1003 |                 r'\(' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\)',
1004 |                 '([?])', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
1005 |             # Remove standalone all-caps ticker as a whole word
1006 |             text = _re.sub(
1007 |                 r'\b' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
1008 |                 '[?]', text)
1009 |             return text
1010 | 
1011 |         # Pick the first article that doesn't lead with the raw ticker symbol
1012 |         chosen = articles[0]
1013 |         for a in articles:
1014 |             if not a["title"].strip().upper().startswith(ticker):
1015 |                 chosen = a
1016 |                 break
1017 | 
1018 |         chosen["title"]   = _scrub(chosen["title"])
1019 |         chosen["summary"] = _scrub(chosen["summary"])[:280]  # cap summary length
1020 | 
1021 |         logger.info("minigame-hint: %s → %s", ticker, chosen["title"][:60])
1022 |         return jsonify(chosen)
1023 | 
1024 |     except Exception as exc:

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 684 | def score_short_interest(short_pct_float) -> float:

 686 |     Score short interest (% of float sold short) as a contrarian signal.
 687 |     - Very low  (<3%)  : neutral — no squeeze fuel, score 55

 698 |     if pct > 20:   return 85.0
 699 |     if pct > 10:   return 75.0

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 |

 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 781 | 
 782 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 783 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 784 |     if diff:
 785 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 786 | 
 787 |     return weights

 181 |     Fast path: if in 5-min price cache, re-score with current weights and return.
 182 |     Fundamentals served from 4-hour cache — yfinance .info fires at most once/4 h.
 183 |     """

 188 |         return cached

 191 |         tk   = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 192 |         hist = tk.history(period="1y", auto_adjust=True)
 193 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 194 |             return None
 195 | 
 196 |         close   = hist["Close"]
 197 |         volume  = hist["Volume"]
 198 |         current = float(close.iloc[-1])
 199 | 
 200 |         change_1d = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-2]) / close.iloc[-2] * 100) \
 201 |                     if len(close) >= 2 else 0.0
 202 |         mom_1m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-21]) / close.iloc[-21] * 100) \

 207 |         ma_50  = float(close.tail(50).mean())  if len(close) >= 50  else current
 208 |         ma_200 = float(close.tail(200).mean()) if len(close) >= 200 else current

 210 |         delta   = close.diff()
 211 |         gain    = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()

 313 | # ── Parallel batch scorer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 314 | _EXECUTOR = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20, thread_name_prefix="stock-fetch")
 315 | 
 316 | 
 317 | def score_tickers_parallel(tickers: list, weights: dict) -> list:
 318 |     """Score tickers in parallel (up to 20 threads). Drops None results."""
 319 |     futures = {_EXECUTOR.submit(fetch_and_score, t, weights): t for t in tickers}
 320 |     results = []
 321 |     for fut in as_completed(futures):
 322 |         try:
 323 |             res = fut.result(timeout=20)
 324 |             if res:
 325 |                 results.append(res)
 326 |         except Exception as exc:
 327 |             logger.warning("Worker error for %s: %s", futures[fut], exc)
 328 |     return results

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 684 | def score_short_interest(short_pct_float) -> float:

 687 |     - Very low  (<3%)  : neutral — no squeeze fuel, score 55

 689 |     - Moderate  (10–20%): elevated but manageable, score 75 (squeeze potential)
 690 |     - High      (20–30%): significant short interest, score 85 (strong squeeze setup)
 691 |     - Very high (>30%) : extreme risk / possible value trap, score 40
 692 |     - Missing data      : neutral 50

 694 |     if short_pct_float is None:
 695 |         return 50.0
 696 |     pct = short_pct_float * 100  # convert 0.12 → 12.0
 697 |     if pct > 30:   return 40.0
 698 |     if pct > 20:   return 85.0
 699 |     if pct > 10:   return 75.0
 700 |     if pct >= 3:   return 65.0

 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 781 | 
 782 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 783 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 784 |     if diff:
 785 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 786 | 
 787 |     return weights

 795 |     return generate_random_weights(), "random"

 800 | def _sanitize(obj):

 802 |     if isinstance(obj, float):
 803 |         return None if (obj != obj or obj == float('inf') or obj == float('-inf')) else obj
 804 |     if isinstance(obj, dict):
 805 |         return {k: _sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
 806 |     if isinstance(obj, list):
 807 |         return [_sanitize(v) for v in obj]
 808 |     return obj

 815 |     result = dict(cached)

 964 | def minigame_hint():
 965 |     """Return one recent news item for a ticker, with the ticker symbol
 966 |     scrubbed from the headline so it doesn't spoil the minigame answer."""
 967 |     ticker = request.args.get("ticker", "").strip().upper()

 972 |         stock  = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 973 |         news   = stock.news or []
 974 | 
 975 |         # yfinance ≥0.2.x wraps articles in a "content" sub-object;
 976 |         # older versions expose fields at the top level — handle both.
 977 |         def _normalise(item: dict) -> dict:
 978 |             c = item.get("content", item)
 979 |             title   = c.get("title", "")
 980 |             summary = c.get("summary", c.get("description", ""))
 981 |             url     = (c.get("canonicalUrl") or c.get("clickThroughUrl") or {}).get("url", "")
 982 |             source  = (c.get("provider") or {}).get("displayName", "")
 983 |             pub     = c.get("pubDate", c.get("providerPublishTime", ""))
 984 |             return {"title": title, "summary": summary, "url": url,
 985 |                     "source": source, "publishedAt": pub}
 986 | 
 987 |         articles = [_normalise(n) for n in news if n]
 988 |         # Filter to articles that have a title and a URL
 989 |         articles = [a for a in articles if a["title"] and a["url"]]
 990 | 
 991 |         if not articles:
 992 |             return jsonify({"error": "No news available for this ticker"}), 404
 993 | 
 994 |         # Scrub the ticker symbol (and common company-name fragments) from
 995 |         # title + summary so the answer is not given away outright.
 996 |         import re as _re
 997 |         def _scrub(text: str) -> str:
 998 |             # Remove bare ticker in parens like "(AAPL)" or "NASDAQ: AAPL"
 999 |             text = _re.sub(
1000 |                 r'\b(NYSE|NASDAQ|AMEX)[\s:]+' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
1001 |                 '[undisclosed]', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
1002 |             text = _re.sub(
1003 |                 r'\(' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\)',
1004 |                 '([?])', text, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
1005 |             # Remove standalone all-caps ticker as a whole word
1006 |             text = _re.sub(
1007 |                 r'\b' + _re.escape(ticker) + r'\b',
1008 |                 '[?]', text)
1009 |             return text
1010 | 
1011 |         # Pick the first article that doesn't lead with the raw ticker symbol
1012 |         chosen = articles[0]
1013 |         for a in articles:
1014 |             if not a["title"].strip().upper().startswith(ticker):
1015 |                 chosen = a
1016 |                 break
1017 | 
1018 |         chosen["title"]   = _scrub(chosen["title"])
1019 |         chosen["summary"] = _scrub(chosen["summary"])[:280]  # cap summary length
1020 | 
1021 |         logger.info("minigame-hint: %s → %s", ticker, chosen["title"][:60])
1022 |         return jsonify(chosen)
1023 | 
1024 |     except Exception as exc:

 177 | # ── Per-ticker fetch + score ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 178 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
 179 |     """
 180 |     Fetch market data for *ticker* and compute a weighted AI score.
 181 |     Fast path: if in 5-min price cache, re-score with current weights and return.
 182 |     Fundamentals served from 4-hour cache — yfinance .info fires at most once/4 h.
 183 |     """
 184 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 185 |     if cached:
 186 |         cached = dict(cached)
 187 |         cached["score"] = _apply_weights(cached["subScores"], weights)
 188 |         return cached
 189 | 
 190 |     try:
 191 |         tk   = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 192 |         hist = tk.history(period="1y", auto_adjust=True)
 193 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 194 |             return None
 195 | 
 196 |         close   = hist["Close"]
 197 |         volume  = hist["Volume"]
 198 |         current = float(close.iloc[-1])
 199 | 
 200 |         change_1d = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-2]) / close.iloc[-2] * 100) \
 201 |                     if len(close) >= 2 else 0.0
 202 |         mom_1m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-21]) / close.iloc[-21] * 100) \
 203 |                     if len(close) >= 21 else 0.0
 204 |         mom_3m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-63]) / close.iloc[-63] * 100) \
 205 |                     if len(close) >= 63 else 0.0
 206 | 
 207 |         ma_50  = float(close.tail(50).mean())  if len(close) >= 50  else current
 208 |         ma_200 = float(close.tail(200).mean()) if len(close) >= 200 else current
 209 | 
 210 |         delta   = close.diff()
 211 |         gain    = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
 212 |         loss    = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
 213 |         rs      = gain / loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 214 |         rsi_val = float(100 - 100 / (1 + rs.iloc[-1]))
 215 |         if np.isnan(rsi_val):
 216 |             rsi_val = 50.0
 217 | 
 218 |         avg_vol   = float(volume.tail(20).mean())
 219 |         spark_raw = close.tail(30).tolist()
 220 |         mn, mx    = min(spark_raw), max(spark_raw)
 221 |         spark     = [round((v - mn) / (mx - mn) * 100, 1) if mx > mn else 50.0
 222 |                      for v in spark_raw]
 223 | 
 224 |         fund = _fund_get(ticker)
 225 |         if fund is None:
 226 |             info       = tk.info
 227 |             pe_raw     = info.get("trailingPE")       or info.get("forwardPE")
 228 |             eps_raw    = info.get("earningsGrowth")   or info.get("revenueGrowth")
 229 |             margin_raw = info.get("profitMargins")
 230 |             debt_raw   = info.get("debtToEquity")
 231 |             short_raw  = info.get("shortPercentOfFloat") or info.get("shortRatio", 0)
 232 |             fund = {
 233 |                 "pe":           float(pe_raw)     if pe_raw     is not None else None,
 234 |                 "epsGrowth":    float(eps_raw)    if eps_raw    is not None else None,
 235 |                 "profitMargin": float(margin_raw) if margin_raw is not None else None,
 236 |                 "debtToEquity": float(debt_raw)   if debt_raw   is not None else None,
 237 |                 "shortPct":     float(short_raw)  if short_raw  is not None else 0.0,
 238 |                 "sector":  info.get("sector", "Unknown"),
 239 |                 "mktCap":  info.get("marketCap"),
 240 |                 "name":    info.get("shortName") or info.get("longName") or ticker,
 241 |             }
 242 |             _fund_set(ticker, fund)
 243 | 
 244 |         sub = {}
 245 |         blend = mom_1m * 0.4 + mom_3m * 0.6
 246 |         sub["momentum"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + blend * 1.5))
 247 | 
 248 |         eg = fund["epsGrowth"]
 249 |         sub["eps"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + eg * 150)) if eg is not None else 50.0
 250 | 
 251 |         pe = fund["pe"]
 252 |         sub["pe"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - (pe - 15) * 1.8)) \
 253 |                     if (pe is not None and pe > 0) else 50.0
 254 | 
 255 |         if current > ma_50 > ma_200:
 256 |             sub["ma"] = 85.0
 257 |         elif current > ma_200:
 258 |             sub["ma"] = 65.0
 259 |         elif current > ma_50:
 260 |             sub["ma"] = 55.0
 261 |         else:
 262 |             sub["ma"] = 30.0
 263 | 
 264 |         pm = fund["profitMargin"]
 265 |         sub["margin"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 50.0 + pm * 250)) if pm is not None else 50.0
 266 | 
 267 |         de = fund["debtToEquity"]
 268 |         sub["debt"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - de * 0.5)) if de is not None else 50.0
 269 | 
 270 |         if rsi_val < 30:
 271 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 80.0
 272 |         elif rsi_val < 45:
 273 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 65.0
 274 |         elif rsi_val < 60:
 275 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 55.0
 276 |         elif rsi_val < 72:
 277 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 40.0
 278 |         else:
 279 |             sub["rsi_score"] = 20.0
 280 | 
 281 |         sp = fund["shortPct"]
 282 |         sub["short"] = min(100.0, max(0.0, 100.0 - sp * 300))
 283 | 
 284 |         score = _apply_weights(sub, weights)
 285 | 
 286 |         result = {
 287 |             "ticker":       ticker,
 288 |             "name":         fund["name"],
 289 |             "currentPrice": round(current, 2),
 290 |             "change1d":     round(change_1d, 2),
 291 |             "ma50":         round(ma_50,  2),
 292 |             "ma200":        round(ma_200, 2),
 293 |             "rsi":          round(rsi_val, 1),
 294 |             "avgVolume":    int(avg_vol),
 295 |             "spark":        spark,
 296 |             "pe":           round(fund["pe"], 2)                 if fund["pe"]           is not None else None,
 297 |             "epsGrowth":    round(fund["epsGrowth"] * 100, 1)    if fund["epsGrowth"]    is not None else None,
 298 |             "profitMargin": round(fund["profitMargin"] * 100, 1) if fund["profitMargin"] is not None else None,
 299 |             "debtToEquity": round(fund["debtToEquity"], 2)       if fund["debtToEquity"] is not None else None,
 300 |             "sector":       fund["sector"],
 301 |             "mktCap":       int(fund["mktCap"]) if fund["mktCap"] is not None else None,
 302 |             "subScores":    {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sub.items()},
 303 |             "score":        score,
 304 |         }
 305 |         _cache_set(ticker, result)
 306 |         return result
 307 | 
 308 |     except Exception as exc:
 309 |         logger.warning("fetch_and_score(%s) failed: %s", ticker, exc)
 310 |         return None

 317 | def score_tickers_parallel(tickers: list, weights: dict) -> list:
 318 |     """Score tickers in parallel (up to 20 threads). Drops None results."""
 319 |     futures = {_EXECUTOR.submit(fetch_and_score, t, weights): t for t in tickers}
 320 |     results = []
 321 |     for fut in as_completed(futures):
 322 |         try:
 323 |             res = fut.result(timeout=20)
 324 |             if res:
 325 |                 results.append(res)
 326 |         except Exception as exc:
 327 |             logger.warning("Worker error for %s: %s", futures[fut], exc)
 328 |     return results

 604 | 
 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 640 |     if pe is None or pe <= 0: return 40.0
 641 |     if pe < 8:   return 55.0
 642 |     if pe <= 15: return 90.0
 643 |     if pe <= 25: return 75.0
 644 |     if pe <= 40: return 55.0
 645 |     return max(0.0, 55.0 - (pe - 40) * 0.5)

 649 |     if eps_growth is None: return 50.0
 650 |     if eps_growth >= 30:  return 100.0
 651 |     if eps_growth >= 15:  return 80.0
 652 |     if eps_growth >= 5:   return 60.0
 653 |     if eps_growth >= 0:   return 45.0
 654 |     return max(0.0, 45.0 + eps_growth)

 662 |     if de < 3.0:  return 40.0
 663 |     return 20.0

 679 |     if 65 < rsi <= 75:   return 60.0

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 781 | 
 782 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 783 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 784 |     if diff:
 785 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 786 | 
 787 |     return weights

 164 | def _random_weights() -> dict:

 171 | def _apply_weights(sub_scores: dict, weights: dict) -> float:

 178 | def fetch_and_score(ticker: str, weights: dict) -> Optional[dict]:

 181 |     Fast path: if in 5-min price cache, re-score with current weights and return.
 182 |     Fundamentals served from 4-hour cache — yfinance .info fires at most once/4 h.
 183 |     """
 184 |     cached = _cache_get(ticker)
 185 |     if cached:
 186 |         cached = dict(cached)
 187 |         cached["score"] = _apply_weights(cached["subScores"], weights)
 188 |         return cached

 191 |         tk   = yf.Ticker(ticker)
 192 |         hist = tk.history(period="1y", auto_adjust=True)
 193 |         if hist.empty or len(hist) < 30:
 194 |             return None
 195 | 
 196 |         close   = hist["Close"]
 197 |         volume  = hist["Volume"]
 198 |         current = float(close.iloc[-1])
 199 | 
 200 |         change_1d = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-2]) / close.iloc[-2] * 100) \
 201 |                     if len(close) >= 2 else 0.0
 202 |         mom_1m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-21]) / close.iloc[-21] * 100) \
 203 |                     if len(close) >= 21 else 0.0
 204 |         mom_3m    = float((close.iloc[-1] - close.iloc[-63]) / close.iloc[-63] * 100) \
 205 |                     if len(close) >= 63 else 0.0
 206 | 
 207 |         ma_50  = float(close.tail(50).mean())  if len(close) >= 50  else current
 208 |         ma_200 = float(close.tail(200).mean()) if len(close) >= 200 else current
 209 | 
 210 |         delta   = close.diff()
 211 |         gain    = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
 212 |         loss    = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
 213 |         rs      = gain / loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 214 |         rsi_val = float(100 - 100 / (1 + rs.iloc[-1]))
 215 |         if np.isnan(rsi_val):

 217 | 
 218 |         avg_vol   = float(volume.tail(20).mean())

 244 |         sub = {}

 247 | 
 248 |         eg = fund["epsGrowth"]

 250 | 
 251 |         pe = fund["pe"]

 255 |         if current > ma_50 > ma_200:

 257 |         elif current > ma_200:

 259 |         elif current > ma_50:

 313 | # ── Parallel batch scorer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 314 | _EXECUTOR = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=20, thread_name_prefix="stock-fetch")
 315 | 
 316 | 
 317 | def score_tickers_parallel(tickers: list, weights: dict) -> list:
 318 |     """Score tickers in parallel (up to 20 threads). Drops None results."""
 319 |     futures = {_EXECUTOR.submit(fetch_and_score, t, weights): t for t in tickers}
 320 |     results = []
 321 |     for fut in as_completed(futures):
 322 |         try:
 323 |             res = fut.result(timeout=20)
 324 |             if res:
 325 |                 results.append(res)
 326 |         except Exception as exc:
 327 |             logger.warning("Worker error for %s: %s", futures[fut], exc)
 328 |     return results

 605 | def compute_rsi(prices: pd.Series, period: int = 14) -> float:
 606 |     delta = prices.diff()
 607 |     gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
 608 |     loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
 609 |     avg_gain = gain.rolling(period).mean()
 610 |     avg_loss = loss.rolling(period).mean()
 611 |     rs = avg_gain / avg_loss.replace(0, np.nan)
 612 |     rsi = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))
 613 |     return float(rsi.iloc[-1]) if not rsi.empty else 50.0
 614 | 
 615 | 
 616 | def compute_momentum_score(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 617 |     if len(prices) < 130:
 618 |         return 50.0
 619 |     ret_1m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-22] - 1) * 100
 620 |     ret_3m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-66] - 1) * 100
 621 |     ret_6m = (prices.iloc[-1] / prices.iloc[-130] - 1) * 100
 622 |     raw = 0.40 * ret_1m + 0.35 * ret_3m + 0.25 * ret_6m
 623 |     return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, 50.0 + raw * 1.5)), 2)
 624 | 
 625 | 
 626 | def moving_average_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> float:
 627 |     if len(prices) < 200:
 628 |         return 50.0
 629 |     price = prices.iloc[-1]
 630 |     ma50  = prices.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
 631 |     ma200 = prices.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
 632 |     score = 50.0
 633 |     if price > ma50:   score += 20
 634 |     if price > ma200:  score += 20
 635 |     if ma50  > ma200:  score += 10   # golden cross territory
 636 |     return min(100.0, score)

 641 |     if pe < 8:   return 55.0
 642 |     if pe <= 15: return 90.0
 643 |     if pe <= 25: return 75.0
 644 |     if pe <= 40: return 55.0
 645 |     return max(0.0, 55.0 - (pe - 40) * 0.5)

 684 | def score_short_interest(short_pct_float) -> float:
 685 |     """
 686 |     Score short interest (% of float sold short) as a contrarian signal.
 687 |     - Very low  (<3%)  : neutral — no squeeze fuel, score 55
 688 |     - Low       (3–10%): healthy skepticism, score 65
 689 |     - Moderate  (10–20%): elevated but manageable, score 75 (squeeze potential)
 690 |     - High      (20–30%): significant short interest, score 85 (strong squeeze setup)
 691 |     - Very high (>30%) : extreme risk / possible value trap, score 40
 692 |     - Missing data      : neutral 50
 693 |     """
 694 |     if short_pct_float is None:
 695 |         return 50.0
 696 |     pct = short_pct_float * 100  # convert 0.12 → 12.0
 697 |     if pct > 30:   return 40.0
 698 |     if pct > 20:   return 85.0
 699 |     if pct > 10:   return 75.0
 700 |     if pct >= 3:   return 65.0
 701 |     return 55.0

 752 | SIGNAL_BOUNDS = {

 764 | def generate_random_weights() -> dict:
 765 |     """
 766 |     Sample weights from a Dirichlet distribution then clamp each signal
 767 |     to its bounds and renormalise so they still sum to 1.0.
 768 |     """
 769 |     # Symmetric Dirichlet with alpha=2 → mild concentration, not too extreme
 770 |     alphas = np.array([2.0] * len(SIGNAL_KEYS))
 771 |     raw    = np.random.dirichlet(alphas)
 772 | 
 773 |     weights = {}
 774 |     for i, key in enumerate(SIGNAL_KEYS):
 775 |         lo, hi = SIGNAL_BOUNDS[key]
 776 |         weights[key] = float(np.clip(raw[i], lo, hi))
 777 | 
 778 |     # Renormalise after clamping
 779 |     total = sum(weights.values())
 780 |     weights = {k: round(v / total, 4) for k, v in weights.items()}
 781 | 
 782 |     # Fix any floating-point rounding so sum == exactly 1.0
 783 |     diff = round(1.0 - sum(weights.values()), 4)
 784 |     if diff:
 785 |         weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] = round(weights[SIGNAL_KEYS[0]] + diff, 4)
 786 | 
 787 |     return weights

 800 | def _sanitize(obj):
 801 |     """Recursively replace NaN/Inf floats with None so jsonify produces valid JSON."""
 802 |     if isinstance(obj, float):
 803 |         return None if (obj != obj or obj == float('inf') or obj == float('-inf')) else obj
 804 |     if isinstance(obj, dict):
 805 |         return {k: _sanitize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
 806 |     if isinstance(obj, list):
 807 |         return [_sanitize(v) for v in obj]
 808 |     return obj

 812 |     """Re-score a cached result under a (possibly different) set of weights."""
 813 |     sub = cached.get("subScores", {})

 815 |     result = dict(cached)

 817 |     return result
